name: Vitamin C 10% Face Serum
subtitle: Brightens Skin & Fades Dark Spots for a Radiant Glow
fullDescription: A potent daily brightening serum with 10% stabilized Vitamin C (Ethyl Ascorbic Acid) to visibly reduce dullness, fade dark spots and even out skin tone, while protecting against everyday environmental damage.

howToUse.steps: Apply 3-4 drops on cleansed face and neck, gently pat until absorbed. Follow with moisturizer and sunscreen.

ingredients: Water/Aqua, Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, Propanediol, Glycerin, Ferulic Acid, Sodium Hyaluronate, Panthenol, Tocopherol, Xanthan Gum, Citric Acid, Phenoxyethanol.

name: Salicylic Acid + LHA Cleanser
subtitle: Reduces Sebum & Prevents Breakout Without Drying Skin
fullDescription: A daily, gentle exfoliating, acne-fighting face cleanser. It combines BHA + LHA (Salicylic Acid + Capryloyl Salicylic Acid) in 2% concentration, providing deep cleansing, pore decongestion & sebum reduction without drying out the skin.

howToUse.steps: Apply on wet face. Pour a small amount into wet hands, rub into a light lather, and massage into face. Rinse thoroughly.

ingredients: Water/Aqua, Glycerin, Propanediol, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate, Decyl Glucoside, Salicylic Acid, Xylitylglucoside, Panthenol, Betaine, Sodium PCA, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Extract, Zinc PCA, Capryloyl Salicylic Acid, Allantoin, Citric Acid.

name: SPF 50 Sunscreen
subtitle: Broad Spectrum Protection Without the White Cast
fullDescription: A lightweight, non-greasy sunscreen with SPF 50 PA++++ that shields skin from UVA/UVB rays and blue light damage, absorbing quickly with a matte, no-white-cast finish suitable for daily wear.

idealFor.skinType: All Skin Types, including Oily & Sensitive

howToUse.steps: Apply generously as the last step of your morning routine, covering face and exposed neck evenly. Reapply every 3-4 hours if outdoors.
howToUse.frequency: AM, daily, and reapply through the day.

ingredients: Water/Aqua, Ethylhexyl Triazone, Bis-Ethylhexyloxyphenol Methoxyphenyl Triazine, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane, Niacinamide, Glycerin, Dimethicone, Allantoin, Tocopheryl Acetate, Phenoxyethanol.

name: Vitamin B5 Moisturizer
subtitle: Deep Hydration for a Repaired, Bouncy Barrier
fullDescription: A rich yet fast-absorbing moisturizer with Vitamin B5 (Panthenol) that replenishes moisture, strengthens the skin barrier and soothes dryness, leaving skin soft, plump and comfortable all day.

howToUse.steps: Take a nickel-sized amount and massage evenly onto face and neck until fully absorbed.

ingredients: Water/Aqua, Panthenol, Glycerin, Squalane, Cetearyl Alcohol, Shea Butter, Ceramide NP, Sodium Hyaluronate, Allantoin, Phenoxyethanol.

name: Niacinamide 10% Face Serum
description: Acne Marks, Acne Prone & Oily Skin
subtitle: Controls Oil & Fades Acne Marks for Clearer Skin
fullDescription: A high-strength 10% Niacinamide + 1% Zinc serum that regulates excess sebum, minimizes the look of pores and fades post-acne marks, without disrupting the skin barrier.

howToUse.steps: Apply 3-4 drops on cleansed face, gently pat until absorbed. Follow with moisturizer.

ingredients: Water/Aqua, Niacinamide, Zinc PCA, Propanediol, Glycerin, Sodium Hyaluronate, Panthenol, Xanthan Gum, Tocopherol, Phenoxyethanol.

name: Vitamin C + E + Ferulic 16% Face Serum
subtitle: Advanced Antioxidant Serum for Spots & Uneven Tone
fullDescription: A high-potency 16% Vitamin C serum boosted with Vitamin E and Ferulic Acid for enhanced stability and antioxidant power, targeting stubborn spots, uneven tone and early signs of dullness.

idealFor.skinType: All Skin Types, except Highly Sensitive

howToUse.steps: Apply 3-4 drops on cleansed, dry face, gently pat until absorbed. Always follow with sunscreen.
howToUse.frequency: AM, every day. Introduce gradually if new to Vitamin C.

ingredients: Water/Aqua, Ascorbic Acid, Tocopherol, Ferulic Acid, Propanediol, Glycerin, Sodium Hyaluronate, Panthenol, Citric Acid, Phenoxyethanol.

name: Retinol 0.3% Face Serum
description: Fine Lines, Wrinkles & Loss of Elasticity
subtitle: Smoothens Fine Lines & Improves Skin Texture Overnight
fullDescription: A night-time anti-aging serum with 0.3% encapsulated Retinol that gradually reduces the look of fine lines, wrinkles and uneven texture while you sleep, minimizing irritation with a slow-release formula.

idealFor.concerns: Fine Lines, Wrinkles & Loss of Elasticity
idealFor.suitableFor: 18+ years of age, not for pregnant/breastfeeding individuals

howToUse.steps: Apply 2-3 drops on cleansed, dry face at night, avoiding the eye area. Follow with a moisturizer.
howToUse.frequency: PM, 2-3 times a week initially, building up to nightly use.

ingredients: Water/Aqua, Encapsulated Retinol, Propanediol, Glycerin, Squalane, Sodium Hyaluronate, Panthenol, Bisabolol, Tocopherol, Phenoxyethanol.

name: AHA PHA BHA 32% Face Peel
subtitle: Weekly Resurfacing Peel for Smoother, Brighter Skin
fullDescription: A dermatologist-inspired 32% acid blend (AHA, BHA & PHA) that resurfaces dead skin cells, fades hyperpigmentation and softens fine lines for visibly smoother, more even-toned skin.

idealFor.skinType: All Skin Types, except Highly Sensitive

howToUse.steps: Apply a thin layer on cleansed, dry face avoiding the eye area. Leave on for 8-10 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with water.
howToUse.frequency: PM, 1-2 times a week. Follow with SPF the next morning.

ingredients: Water/Aqua, Glycolic Acid, Lactic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Gluconolactone, Propanediol, Glycerin, Allantoin, Panthenol, Sodium Hydroxide, Phenoxyethanol.

name: Nonapeptide + AHA 6% Underarm Roll-On

ingredients: Water/Aqua, Nonapeptide-1, Glycolic Acid, Niacinamide, Glycerin, Propanediol, Allantoin, Sodium Hyaluronate, Phenoxyethanol.

ingredients: Water/Aqua, Glycerin, Decyl Glucoside, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Panthenol, Sodium PCA, Betaine, Allantoin, Xylitylglucoside, Citric Acid.
